MAT	<p>b36d_a5b3</p> <p>Match each of the following inheritance patterns with their corresponding definitions.</p><p><i>Note:</i> Each choice will be used exactly once.</p>	<span style="color: #616205;">complete dominance</span>	one allele masks the effect of another allele	<span style="color: #793ca7;">incomplete dominance</span>	heterozygote appearance is a blended phenotype of both homozygous phenotypes	<span style="color: #006d5d;">epistasis</span>	one gene suppresses the effect of another gene that is<strong> <strong>NOT</strong> </strong>its allele	<span style="color: #a32e30;">codominance</span>	heterozygotes equally express both alleles in the phenotype
